sn34.3:1.5: One meditator is skilled in emerging from immersion but not in immersion.
sn34.3:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in immersion nor in emerging from it.
sn34.3:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in immersion and in emerging from it.
sn34.3:1.8: Of these, the meditator skilled both in immersion and in emerging from it is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
